name: DENT 5444
title: Epidemiology of Oral Diseases: Interpreting the Literature
description: Provides a basic understanding of epidemiologic principles to enable the critical review of the literature and to provide a methodological framework with which to better understand basic statistics. An overview of the specific epidemiology of oral diseases will be provided.
requirement_description: Open only to current UConn Health Dental Residents in the combined Certificate/Master of Dental Science Program.
